svg.title: Koi pond size: how many koi per pond?
svg.desc: Planning rule: 500 gallons per adult koi for comfortable stocking, 250 as the absolute ceiling. Ponds at least 3 feet deep.
svg.text: Koi pond size: how many koi per pond?
Planning rule: 500 gallons per adult koi for comfortable stocking, 250 as the absolute ceiling. Ponds at least 3 feet deep.
Counts are for adult koi at 24 inches or more; a young group looks under-stocked for its first few years. fishcareai.com
